# The Intentional Inclusion Celebration (TIIC)

> A free, family-friendly festival celebrating life, talent and belonging, held on the UN International Day of Persons with Disabilities. 3 December 2026, 2:00 to 7:00 PM (UTC+04:00), GEMS Dubai American Academy, Al Barsha, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Entry is free; everyone is welcome.

Site: https://tiic.intentional.ae/

## The event

- Name: The Intentional Inclusion Celebration (TIIC)
- Tagline: A celebration of life
- Date: Thursday 3 December 2026, the UN International Day of Persons with Disabilities
- Time: 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM Gulf Standard Time (UTC+04:00)
- Venue: GEMS Dubai American Academy, Al Barsha, Dubai, UAE
- Cost: Free entry, everyone welcome
- Expected attendance: around eight hundred guests
- Format: eight zones running across the five hours, not a fixed timetable. Arrive when you like, leave when you need to, come back.
- Zones: Inspiration & Learning, Live Performances, Arts & Creativity, Family Entertainment, Community Marketplace, Wellbeing & Therapy, Sports Hall, Community Connections

## Who it is for

Everyone. The festival is built with and for People of Determination (the UAE term for people with disabilities), their families, carers, educators and advocates, and the wider Dubai community. The programme is built from the community rather than booked from an agency: performers, artists, therapists and stallholders are local people and organisations.

Access provision includes step-free routes and accessible restrooms throughout, quiet and decompression spaces away from the main stage, accessibility-trained volunteers, shaded and senior-friendly seating, free water and cooling stations, and caregiver and family support areas. Some details (accessible parking, step-free drop-off, sign language interpretation, Changing Places facilities, assistance dog arrangements) were still being confirmed with the venue as of September 2026 and are listed openly as unconfirmed on the accessibility page.

## Registering

Registration is free and takes about a minute. It is how the team plans seating, food, volunteers and quiet spaces, and it is where guests state their access needs.

- Register: https://tiic.intentional.ae/register/
- Form (Tally): https://tally.so/r/7RaMbR
- By email: tiic@intentional.ae
- By WhatsApp: https://wa.me/971504519627

## Who runs it

- Presented by: The Intentional Group, https://intentional.ae. Founded by Charles Donald, an engineer who has worked in Dubai since 1989. TIIC grew out of his buying a painting by Abheek, an autistic artist.
- Event management: Top Talents International, which holds the event licence and handles production, staffing and on-site delivery. bookings@toptalents.com, +971 55 607 8232
- Website built by NeoForge, https://neoforge.co
